messages:
maria: CI smoke failing on hosted integration after the session token rotation deploy — seeing 401s and truncated streams across auth/stream/toolcall tests. Failing consistently on shard 3.

alex: saw same on my rerun. Logs show the session token was rotated mid-connection, client got a 401 on later frames. Snippet: ```2026-03-16T14:12:03Z INFO auth: rotated token for session 0x7ff, conn 42 -> token_id=rot-2026-03-16```

taylor: pinging infra — any rolling session rotate job that could invalidate some router caches? @infra-bot

infra-bot: Scheduled: session-rotate at 14:00 UTC completed. No errors reported. (incident:false)

infra: looking into it. can you paste the failing job id and shard? also are these smoke runs against hosted prod or staging? @maria

maria: Job ci/integration/smoke/enc-7 (shard 3). Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/19674. Repro steps: `./test.sh --suite smoke --shard 3 --target hosted-api --auth=oauth`. Local/dev-hosted runs pass.

alex: I reran once and it passed, reran again and it failed — flaky. My hunch: token rotated and a subset of routers still served cached session info, creating a race for in-flight streams.

taylor: can we add temporary debug logging to include auth header hash + session token id on both router and runtime? small patch proposed: https://gh/internal/p/12345 (safe logging)

maria: infra, can you rerun shard 3 with extra debug logging enabled and capture kvcache/redis stats? also please keep artifacts.

infra: will do. kicking parallel reruns with CI_DEBUG_AUTH=1 and capturing Redis INFO snapshots. starting 3 reruns now.

infra-bot: Rerun started: ci/integration/smoke/enc-7 (shard 3) attempt 1 -> 1967501560

maria: if it repros please grab router auth cache metrics and runtime logs: `redis:INFO` snapshot, `router.metrics.auth_cache_hits` and `runtime.auth.token_id` lines.

infra-bot: Attempt 1 result: FLAKE — 401 during streaming frame. Logs: https://artifacts/1967501560/logs. Attempt 2 queued -> 1967501680

alex: from the uploaded logs I see: `auth: token_lookup miss -> fetching from KMS` followed immediately by `auth: token_rotated` then `stream: client closed: 401` — rotation happened mid-request.

taylor: can we toggle a grace window for token acceptance? if we can set rotation_grace_secs to 30/60 temporarily that might stop in-flight failures.

infra: there is a feature flag for rotation grace. toggling to 60s for affected routers and kicking a new run.

infra-bot: Attempt 2 result: PASS. Scheduling Attempt 3 -> 1967501850

maria: looks like increasing the grace window helps. long-term we need a fix: either ensure in-flight requests are honored for previous token for a grace period or make KV invalidation atomic across router fleet.

taylor: filing a bisect request and assigning to the auth team. @alex can you bisect between PRs 980..1005 (those that touched rotation/invalidation)? add a harness that simulates concurrent rotate during active streaming.

alex: will start bisect now, will post the likely offending commit. i’ll also include tool-calling smoke tests because signed headers for tool calls are failing similarly.

maria: thanks — include toolcall tests in the bisect set too. they fail with very similar 401/short stream symptoms.

infra: debug artifacts and logs will be retained for 72h. if anyone needs longer, DM and we'll extend.

chris: quick note for runbook: add how to toggle rotation_grace_secs and how to rerun specific shards with debug flags. I'll add docs at docs/runbooks/session-rotation.md

maria: ack. we'll close this thread after bisect/PR lands. :thumbsup:
